sentences.text:
Bench: Bibek Chaudhuri
04.07.2022 Item No.63 Suman Ct.42 Crr 2270 of 2022 Baldeo Prasad Kedia Vs.

The petitioner has come up with the instant application for setting aside of the order dated 31st May, 2022 passed by the learned Additional District and Sessions Judge, Bench-II, City Sessions Court, Calcutta in connection with Criminal Appeal No.29 of 2014 affirming the judgment and order dated 17 th January, 2014 passed by the learned Senior Municipal Magistrate, Calcutta in connection with case No.1D/08 under Section 16(1)(a)(i) read with Section 7 of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954.

entities.text: Additional District and Sessions Judge, Bench-II, City Sessions Court, Calcutta
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: I have heard the learned advocate for the petitioner and perused the materials on record.
The instant revision is admitted for hearing.
The petitioner is directed to serve notice upon the opposite party No.2 under registered speed post with A/D and shall file affidavit of service within three weeks from the date.
The petitioner shall also serve the State of West Bengal through the learned Public Prosecutor, High Court, Calcutta.

In the meantime, there shall be an interim order of stay of the order dated 31 st May, 2022 in connection with Criminal Appeal No.29 of 2014 passed by the learned Additional District and Sessions Judge, Bench-II, City Sessions Court, Calcutta till 31 st August, 2022.

entities.text: Additional District and Sessions Judge, Bench-II, City Sessions Court, Calcutta
entities.label: COURT
